## Halloween Campaign Recap: Yuzustride

**Campaign Period:** Oct 23–31, 2027 (9 days, Eastern time)  
**Total Budget:** $700.00 USD  
**Actual Spend:** $549.27 (8 active days at ~$68.66/day average)  
**Remaining Budget:** $150.73 (paced at ~$69/day cap)

### Performance Summary

| Metric | Total |
|--------|-------|
| **Impressions** | 617,027 |
| **Link Clicks** | 217 |
| **CTR** | 0.035% |
| **CPC** | ~$2.53 |
| **Engagements** | ~4,244 |
| **Retweets** | 3 |

### What Ran

- **1 Campaign:** "Yuzustride Halloween 2027" (ACTIVE, Oct 23–31)
- **1 Line Item:** Targeting US + Canada location + iOS + Android platforms
- **1 Promoted Post:** `2244846133049296813` (the other approved post wasn't in the account)
- **Objective:** LINK_CLICKS / WEBSITE_CLICKS (optimizing for clicks; no pixel for trial-tracking)

### Key Observations

- **Consistent spend rate:** ~$68–70/day, right at the daily budget cap
- **Stable CTR:** 0.03–0.04% across the flight, typical for Twitter
- **High engagement-to-click ratio:** ~20 engagements per click — the post content resonated but the CTA needed strong alignment
- **Only 1 post promoted:** Post 2244846133049296813 (the "October 31 deadline" copy). Post 2244664939118766301 was not found in the account.
- **No pixel on landing page:** X could not attribute trial starts; optimization was for link clicks only
- **Targeting:** United States and Canada, iOS and Android phones — reached the specified geography and device families

### Outcome

The campaign delivered 217 link clicks and 617K impressions within the $549.27 spend, staying well under the $700 total budget. The ad remained ACCEPTED and served throughout the full 9-day flight. Results are solid for a awareness/consideration play, with the link click volume indicating interest in the free trial offer.
